claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the UConn men's basketball team.
Dan Hurley has led the UConn men's basketball team since 2018.
The UConn Huskies won back-to-back NCAA championships in 2023 and 2024.
Dan Hurley coached at Wagner before coming to UConn.
Dan Hurley coached at Rhode Island before coming to UConn.
Dan Hurley coached at St. Benedict's Prep before coming to UConn.
Dan Hurley has a record of 165-69 over 7 seasons with the UConn Huskies as of March 2026.
Dan Hurley has led UConn to at least seven NCAA Tournament appearances.
In March 2026, it was reported that UConn assistant coach Luke Murray was hired as the head coach for Boston College.
